actions.bika_find_records.props.offset.d: To continue a previous search, paste the offset it returned. Leave empty to start from the first record.
actions.bika_find_records.props.pageSize: How many records to fetch per API request (default 100, at most 1,000). Larger pages use fewer of your Bika API requests.

actions.bika_update_record.props.space_i: The Bika space that holds the database.

auth.description:
Connect Bika.ai with a personal API token.

1. Sign in to [Bika.ai](https://bika.ai).
2. Click your avatar at the bottom left and open **My Settings**.
3. Open **Developer** and click **Generate new token**.
4. Copy the token and paste it below.

The token can reach every space your Bika user belongs to. On the Free plan each space allows 100 API requests a month.
auth.props.token.description: The API token from Bika (My Settings > Developer).
